name: Energetic Flyby
description: A continuous flight down a twisting tunnel of glassy, perforated shells lit from inside, following a cluster of spiked, spinning spheres that throw light rods through the tunnel. Kali's Energetic Flyby (Shadertoy csjGDD, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0) ported verbatim. Each downbeat on the cached grid (barPhase01) bursts the sphere light and turns its colour, with a smaller echo on beat 3; every second downbeat banks the camera a quarter turn. The song's energy (spectralFlux, self-normalised) sets the flight speed and glow floor; the bass (bassDev, self-normalised) spins the spheres.
author: Kali (port: Uzume engine)

audio_routes.note: EFB.1 — each wrap of the cached grid's barPhase01 is a downbeat: the sphere-core light bursts (decay 0.35 s, bounded to the cluster, D-157) and the glow colour steps 0.7 rad along pink -> orange -> pink -> blue (inside Kali's range); a 0.35 echo when barPhase01 x beatsPerBar crosses 2 (beat 3, meters of 4+); every second downbeat banks the camera a quarter turn over 1 s. EnergeticFlybyState.
EFB.1 — spectralFlux self-normalised against its own running mean (8 s warm-up rule, FH.17), smoothed 0.6 s: flight speed 0.65 + 0.8 x energy and glow floor 0.45 + 0.5 x energy.
EFB.1 — positive bassDev self-normalised the same way, attack 30 ms / release 300 ms: sphere spin rate 1 + 3 x bass.
